title: Proposal Envelope
description: Schema for the 'proposal' key in a script's result envelope. Validated before INSERT INTO proposal when the standard declares a proposal_template.

location.description: File path where the proposal content lives

metadata.description: Presentation-layer metadata for rendering (summary, content_md, computed_context)

phases.description: Phase-wise breakdown of the proposal. Must be non-empty.

domain.description: Domain key this phase covers — must exist in domain table for this standard

usecases.description: Usecase names in this phase — must belong to the declared domain

steps.description: Step IDs in this phase — must belong to one of the phase's usecases

rationale.description: Why this phase boundary was chosen

git.description: Git state at time of generation — cross-checked against capture_git_state result

commit_sha.description: Full commit SHA — must exist in repo and be ancestor of HEAD
